nodes.label: Human Review Gate (person reviews every deck)
nodes.rationale: A person reviews every deck before it goes out; nothing is sent automatically and no AI writes the story - keeps quality control on a client-facing sales asset.
nodes.norm_label: human review gate (person reviews every deck)

nodes.label: Prepaid Credit Cost Model
nodes.rationale: Prepaid vendor credits (not a monthly software seat) keep cost variable and capped instead of committing to a recurring subscription.

nodes.label: Thin-Data Fallback Rule
nodes.rationale: Tiny or new websites often have little keyword data; dropping the data-thin slides and showing more technical findings lets the deck still go out instead of blocking on missing data.

nodes.label: Staff Login Only (internal tool, not public product)
nodes.rationale: This is a sales leave-behind tool, not a public product, so it is gated to staff login only.
nodes.norm_label: staff login only (internal tool, not public product)

nodes.label: Priorities + CTA (operator-edited template)
nodes.rationale: The final slide is a human-edited app template, not AI-generated or vendor-sourced, to keep the narrative accurate and on-brand; booking link comes from env config.

nodes.label: Thin-Data Rule
nodes.rationale: If Labs returns little or no keyword data, drop the organic snapshot, quick wins, and competitor gap features but keep PageSpeed + OnPage and referring domains so the deck still goes out.

nodes.label: Ahrefs / Semrush (excluded)
nodes.rationale: Requires a monthly subscription; CEO brief calls for prepaid credits only, so excluded.

nodes.label: DataForSEO Lighthouse / OnPage CWV (excluded)
nodes.rationale: Duplicate of PageSpeed Insights data at extra cost, so excluded in favor of the free PageSpeed API.

nodes.label: Google Analytics (excluded)
nodes.rationale: Needs the prospect's own account access; this is a cold sales leave-behind with no prospect login, so excluded.

nodes.label: Google Search Console (excluded)
nodes.rationale: Same reason as Analytics - requires prospect login, unavailable for a cold outreach tool.

nodes.label: Screaming Frog (excluded)
nodes.rationale: Desktop crawler application, not an API, so unsuitable for this internal automated tool.

nodes.label: NH Brand Template (NH Blue 1158E5, DM Sans, Calibri fallback)
nodes.norm_label: nh brand template (nh blue 1158e5, dm sans, calibri fallback)

nodes.label: Basic Auth (API login/password)
nodes.rationale: DataForSEO API uses basic auth with login/password from the vendor dashboard.

nodes.label: Environment-Variable Credential Storage
nodes.rationale: Credentials must be kept in environment variables, never committed to the repo.

nodes.label: Estimated-Label Rule
nodes.rationale: Traffic and keyword figures are modeled/estimated, not verified analytics, so every such figure must be labeled Estimated on the slide.

nodes.label: Referring-Domains-Only Rule
nodes.rationale: Show only referring domain counts, never total backlink counts, since different tools report different, incomparable backlink totals.

nodes.label: Thin-Data Fallback (drop slides 3, 4, 7)
nodes.rationale: If Labs returns little or no data for small or new sites, drop slides 3, 4, and 7 and expand the technical findings instead.
